title: English Practice Quiz 0949
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A 'feasible' plan is one that is ___.
options: practical and possible to carry out
questions.explanation: Feasible means capable of being done successfully.

questions.question: To 'exacerbate' a problem means to ___.
questions.explanation: Exacerbate means increase the severity of something.

questions.question: A 'concise' report is ___.
questions.explanation: Concise writing communicates the main points in few words.

questions.question: A 'consensus' is a general ___.
questions.explanation: Consensus is a broadly shared agreement.

questions.question: To 'allocate' resources means to ___.
questions.explanation: Allocate means assign or distribute resources.

questions.question: A 'rigorous' assessment is ___.
questions.explanation: Rigorous means extremely thorough and accurate.

questions.question: An 'obsolete' device is ___.
options: outdated and no longer commonly used
still being manufactured for every purpose
questions.explanation: Obsolete means out of date or no longer in use.

questions.question: To 'infer' something means to ___.
questions.explanation: Infer means draw a conclusion based on available information.

questions.question: A 'substantial' improvement is ___.
questions.explanation: Substantial means large or important in amount or degree.

questions.question: To 'verify' a claim is to ___.
options: check whether it is true or accurate
questions.explanation: Verify means establish the truth or accuracy of something.
